text:
kai: Quick flag  rolling a streaming route policy tweak to prefer `fast-path` on canary. ~7m later we got reconnect spikes + duplicate token billing for a small tenant cohort. console alert ALRT-9901. anyone watching? :grimace:

nora: saw ALRT-9901. p95 reconnect up on eu shards. link: https://console.redwood/api/alerts/ALRT-9901

kai: logs (redacted):
```
2026-06-12T08:03:10Z INFO route-flip session=tm-77 prev=eu-west-2 next=eu-central-1
2026-06-12T08:03:11Z INFO resume-accepted session=tm-77 shard=eu-central-1
2026-06-12T08:03:11Z WARN quick-reconnect session=tm-77 shard=eu-west-2
2026-06-12T08:03:12Z INFO billed_tokens session=tm-77 tokens=46
```

diego: pattern looks like resume success on new shard + near-immediate retry to old shard -> KV prefix miss -> full regen & billing. console sampling for reconnect traces is 0.5% so the per-shard jump was invisible until billing showed up.

nora: immediate mitigations I suggest: 1) bump `reconnect.sample_frac` to 0.15 for eu-* for 20m (diagnostics) 2) add a small 15s "previous-shard affinity" soft window during mode flips 3) push a per-route duplicate_tokens tile to the canary dashboard with tenant drilldown.

kai: agree. also low-risk stopgap: add a cheap billing dedupe keyed by (resume_id, tenant_id) TTL=6s to ignore near-duplicate charges while we debug. can run behind a flag.

product-console: UX note: rollout page should show critical telemetry sampling fractions and suggest bumping them for route-sensitive changes. this blindspot keeps showing up. small CTA would help.

diego: one more idea: short-lived console alert if duplicate_tokens_rate / reconnect_rate > 0.3 for any route in canary window  good proxy for misrouted resumes.

kai: action list:
- kai: flip previous-shard affinity TTL=15s for current canary (doing now)
- diego: bump reconnect.sample_frac eu->0.15 for 20m and add per-route duplicate tile
- nora: prototype billing dedupe (resume_id, tenant) behind feature flag TTL=6s
- product-console: add rollout sampling CTA + link to telemetry settings
- diego: add ratio-based alarm prototype

ops-bot: [automated] ALRT-9901 acknowledged by kai. Incident INC-9920 created.

diego: quick query shows duplicate_tokens spike at T+3m and lines up with the route-flip. original shard CPU +13% during the spike. pushing dashboard now.

kai: affinity TTL active. monitoring. if duplicates don't drop in 10m we roll back the canary. thanks all. :thumbsup:
